column1: # Revetsec's expected outcomes for the Project Wycheproof JSON Web Signature and JSON Web Key vectors (plan M2-9), as
# the JOSE runner com.revetsec.internal.jose.WycheproofJoseTests observes them through the internal JWS layer. The
# vectors are C2SP/wycheproof's testvectors_v1 at 3fa63dd0344abb611f1fb1d77e119938603ea230, vendored under
# src/test/resources/vectors/wycheproof/. Reason codes are JoseException.Reason names; n/a marks key-set semantics
# that the HMAC engine's one configured secret cannot express.
# Format (see WycheproofSignatureTests.Expectations): one line per exception, five TAB-separated fields:
#   file <TAB> tcId=<n> or rule:<name> <TAB> jdk <TAB> outcome <TAB> note
# jdk is all, <n>, <n>+ or <n>-<m> (Java feature releases, 17 and up); outcome is accept, reject:<code> or n/a.
# A vector with no line expects accept if upstream marks it valid, and any rejection if invalid; every acceptable
# vector needs a line. A #count line pins a file's outcome counts, reason by reason, on the releases it names; each
# file has exactly one for every release. A stale, duplicate or overlapping line, or a count that no longer holds,
# fails the build.
# Outcome counts, measured on Corretto 17.0.20.1, 21, 25, 26 and 27 (all agree).
#count
